definition.name: TypeScript guest value and ownership boundary

steps.name: Capture immutable qualification source inputs
steps.run:
# Retain every input used below, including the pinned compiler lock.
# Historical benchmark archives are not inputs to this runtime lane.
git archive --format=tar.gz --output "$RUNNER_TEMP/typescript-guest-source.tar.gz" HEAD -- \
  apps sdk/typescript-guest sdk/rust examples tools crates wit schemas docs .cargo \
  Cargo.toml Cargo.lock rust-toolchain.toml LICENSE NOTICE .github/workflows/typescript-guest.yml
test "$(stat --format=%s "$RUNNER_TEMP/typescript-guest-source.tar.gz")" -le 134217728
git rev-parse HEAD > "$RUNNER_TEMP/typescript-guest-source.sha"

steps.name: Retain the exact reviewed command contract input
Install the reviewed JavaScript compiler inputs
Qualify proposed transaction shapes with the maintained stackful TypeScript compiler
Execute the compiled async-boundary diagnostic
steps.run:
set -o pipefail
cargo --config .cargo/managed-guest.toml run --locked -p latent-wasmtime --example typescript_runtime_probe -- "$RUNNER_TEMP/typescript-guest-probe/component.wasm" 2>&1 | tee "$RUNNER_TEMP/typescript-guest-probe/runtime.log"

steps.name: Execute supplementary value and ownership models
steps.run:
set -o pipefail
mkdir -p target/typescript-guest-runtime
node "$RUNNER_TEMP/typescript-guest-tools/node_modules/typescript/bin/tsc" --target ES2022 --module NodeNext --moduleResolution NodeNext --strict --lib ES2022 --outDir target/typescript-guest-runtime sdk/typescript-guest/runtime/*.ts sdk/typescript-guest/tests/model/*.ts
printf '{"type":"module"}\n' > target/typescript-guest-runtime/package.json
LSF_TYPESCRIPT_RUNTIME="$PWD/target/typescript-guest-runtime/tests/model" node --test sdk/typescript-guest/tests/runtime.test.mjs 2>&1 | tee target/typescript-guest-runtime/runtime-tests.log

steps.name: Check captured sources and actual generated-resource owners
steps.run:
set -euo pipefail
python3 -m pip install -r tools/requirements.lock
python3 -m unittest tools.tests.test_typescript_capsule_authoring tools.tests.test_build_provenance_schemas
node "$RUNNER_TEMP/typescript-guest-tools/node_modules/typescript/bin/tsc" --target ES2022 --module NodeNext --moduleResolution NodeNext --strict --lib ES2022 --outDir target/typescript-owner-tests sdk/typescript-guest/capabilities/owner.ts sdk/typescript-guest/capabilities/result.ts
printf '{"type":"module"}\n' > target/typescript-owner-tests/package.json
LSF_TYPESCRIPT_OWNERS="$PWD/target/typescript-owner-tests" node --test sdk/typescript-guest/tests/owner.test.mjs sdk/typescript-guest/tests/signed64.test.mjs 2>&1 | tee target/typescript-guest-runtime/owner-tests.log

steps.name: Qualify captured projects, all SDK owners, enforced node and printed guide
